title: Cocone extension of raw pullback coherence
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $I$ any preorder and $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Over}(S)$ any diagram with cone $c$. Write $g_i:X_i\to S$, $g:X\to S$, $a_f:X_j\to X_i$ and $a_i:X\to X_i$ for its structure, transition and cone maps. Let $F_i$ be abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], with coefficient maps $\varphi_f:a_f^{-1}F_i\to F_j$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], satisfying $\varphi_{1_i}=e_{X_i,F_i}$ and $\varphi_{f;g}=C_{a_g,a_f,F_i};a_g^{-1}(\varphi_f);\varphi_g$, where $e$ is the canonical inverse-image identity comparison and $C:(a_g;a_f)^{-1}\simeq a_g^{-1}a_f^{-1}$ is the canonical composition comparison. These equalities include the canonical transports along the identity and composition equalities of $D$. Let $H:I\to\mathrm{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{et}},\mathbf{Ab})$ have a colimit, with $eH_i:H_i\simeq a_i^{-1}F_i$ and canonical transition equation $H(f)=eH_i;\mathrm{upperStarComp};a_j^{-1}(\varphi_f);eH_j^{-1}$. Fix $p\in\mathbf N$. Put $A_i=\mathrm{raw}(g_i,p,F_i)$ and $Z=\mathrm{raw}(g,p,\operatorname{colim}H)$, the derived-Hom presheaves of [lem-sbc-abelian-higher-direct-image-natural-comparison]. Let $\tau_f:A_i\to A_j$ and $\beta_i:A_i\to Z$ be any natural transformations whose components at each etale $V\to S$ equal the explicit raw pullbacks along $(a_f,\varphi_f)$ and $(a_i,eH_i^{-1};\iota_i)$ respectively. Then $\tau_f;\beta_j=\beta_i$ for every $f:i\to j$. Neither identity nor composition laws for $\tau$ are assumed. No directedness, nonemptiness, limit, affineness or qcqs assumption is needed.

proof.text: Transport d, hprime and hsecond along wd, wa and wb to reduce to composable a, b, h. Prove the five-factor equality first with an arbitrary Grothendieck abelian coefficient category and arbitrary source sheaf M on S; this keeps concrete abelian-group instance constructions out of the kernel calculation. Specialize M to the represented free sheaf used by the raw presheaf, and the coefficient category to abelian groups. These are actual functors and actual morphisms, with no chosen existence witnesses.

Write P=a inverse image, Q=b inverse image, R=(b;a) inverse image, sigmaP, sigmaQ, sigmaR for their single-complex comparison isomorphisms, kappa for upperStarComp(b,a), and theta for upperStarPlusComp(b,a). The existing generic plus_single_comp and plus_single_natIso give sigmaR.hom;single(kappa);sigmaQ.inv = theta;D(Q)(sigmaP.hom), after cancelling sigmaQ.hom. This is h_sigma. The existing private plusNatIso_commShift and plusCompIso_commShift, imported with import all, show theta.hom commutes with shifts. No adjunction transition theorem or unproved coherence statement is used.

For source sheaf M, apply the already proved source-library upperStarComp_assoc' in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.BaseChange.Pasting to b,a,h and evaluate on M. It says the b versus a;h source comparison followed by Q of the a versus h source comparison equals the b;a versus h comparison followed by kappa. Move the former comparison through sigmaQ.inv by naturality, precompose h_sigma with sigmaR.inv, and postcompose with D(Q)(sigmaP.inv). Cancelling sigmaR.inv;hom and the mapped sigmaP.hom;inv gives y;D(Q)(x)=zprime;theta at the source. The private generic lemma singleComparison_source performs exactly these elementary categorical rewrites.

Postcompose h_sigma at F with sigmaQ.hom(P F), cancelling sigmaQ.inv;hom. Naturality of sigmaQ.hom at phi then gives theta;D(Q)(sigmaP.hom;single(phi));sigmaQ.hom;single(psi) = sigmaR.hom;single(kappa;Q(phi);psi). This is singleComparison_target, the unshifted coefficient equality.

Expand the outer functor over the inner five factors. The private generic shiftedHom_comp first moves the Q shift comparison through the shifted inner coefficient morphism by naturality, then uses the source equality. Naturality of theta moves theta past the class z. NatTrans.shift_app_comm, together with the formula for the shift comparison of a composite functor, moves theta through the two shift comparisons. Functoriality of shift combines the three shifted coefficient factors, and the coefficient equality identifies them with the direct coefficient. These are precisely the direct five factors. Scheme-equality witnesses agree by proof irrelevance. The calculation works for identities, zero coefficients or classes, empty schemes, and p=0.

Precompose colimit.w H f with (eH i).inv and substitute hH f. Associativity and the inverse-hom cancellation for eH i show that upperStarComp followed by pullback of phi f followed by (eH j).inv followed by colimit.ι H j equals (eH i).inv followed by colimit.ι H i. This is the coefficient equality hc in the Lean proof. No assumption on phi identities or composites enters.

Use natural-transformation and group-homomorphism extensionality. At op V and a class t, substitute hbeta j, htau f, and hbeta i. Apply the arbitrary-coefficient raw composition theorem to the transition and the j-th cone leg, using congrArg Over.Hom.left of cone naturality for their composite. Rewrite its coefficient using hc. The resulting class is the i-th cone-leg raw pullback, so the two components agree.
